vehicles.name: Dzo Hatch
vehicles.blurb: Your first wheels: a small, willing hatchback. Underpowered on hills, thrifty with fuel, hopeless in mud.

vehicles.name: Tourist Coaster
vehicles.blurb: Tourist minibus. Heavy and wide, with a lazy lean: brake early and flow through the bends.

vehicles.name: Druk Ranger
vehicles.blurb: Capable SUV with selectable 4x2 / 4x4. Quick, grippy, and happy on a hairpin or a muddy hill.

vehicles.name: Dragon Cruiser
vehicles.blurb: Flagship expedition 4x4. Torquey, tall, locked-in grip: it fords rivers and climbs almost anything.

routes.name: Pass Run
routes.subtitle: Village to the prayer-flag pass
routes.summary: Your first real tourism run: collect a family from the village, pick up a hiker on the trail, swap guests at the viewpoint and deliver everyone to the summit plaza. A long, scenic climb with a fuel stop, a workshop...

routes.name: Thimphu Town Pickup
routes.subtitle: City streets to Buddha Dordenma
routes.summary: A guest-filled morning: collect a couple at Babesa, a late guest at the hotel, drop one at the Memorial Chorten, fetch the tour guide from the busy commercial streets, and bring everyone through the congestion and up...

routes.name: Airport Dash
routes.subtitle: Thimphu to the departure gate
routes.summary: A tour group is dangerously late for their flight. Load them up at the hotel, pick up the last straggler, and drive the Thimphu to Paro highway: river, gorge, roadworks and all. A smooth ride keeps the passengers...

routes.name: Punakha Valley Tour
routes.subtitle: Two rivers and a dzong
routes.summary: The valley is at its greenest, and the guests want all of it: the rice terraces, the villages, the river road, a lunch they are sure is still cooking, and the dzong where two rivers meet. Rain, mud, a narrow bridge,...

routes.name: Dochula Storm Descent
routes.subtitle: Down the pass before the storm peaks
routes.summary: The tourists lingered too long at the 108 chortens, and a mountain storm is now rolling over the pass. Cloud will swallow the road, fog will hide the trucks, rain will turn the hairpins to glass and a landslide waits...

routes.name: Trongsa Gorge Run
routes.subtitle: The road with the drop
routes.summary: A group of tourists needs to reach Trongsa through the roughest mountains in central Bhutan, on a road that is narrow, patched, and increasingly unpredictable. A cliff ledge, a gorge that cooks the brakes, a one-lane...

routes.name: Chelela Hill Climb
routes.subtitle: Up to the snow and the high pass
routes.summary: The tourists insist on seeing Chele La, the highest road pass in Bhutan, and the weather has other plans. Climb from the Paro foothills through forest and fourteen hairpins to the snowy viewpoint: frost, packed snow,...

routes.name: Bumthang Night Expedition
routes.subtitle: Forest roads after dark
routes.summary: A group of tourists left it too late to leave Bumthang. Now the sun is going down on a long, lonely forest road: unlit bridges, fog in the settlements, animals in the headlights, and some things in the headlights...

routes.name: Eastern Tshechu Expedition
routes.subtitle: Mud, rocks and rivers
routes.summary: A documentary team, forty cases of gear and a tent that does not fit in the car have to reach a remote expedition camp. The tracks are mud, the highway is broken, the bridge is in the river, the mountain keeps...

routes.name: GMC Plains Challenge
routes.subtitle: The long road to Gelephu
routes.summary: The final assignment: bring a manifest of guests from a southern mountain lodge to the Gelephu Mindfulness City arrival hall, over everything the kingdom can throw at a car: a brake-cooking descent, landslides, mud,...
